newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia SBI index falls 3.3 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia SBI index falls 3.3 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: The Slovenian blue-chip SBI share index fell 3.30 percent on Tuesday on what traders said was profit-taking combined with selling from small shareholders prior to the summer holidays.
Market participants forecast that the market would drift sideways for the rest of the week.
* The SBI index fell 47.62 points to 1,396.68.
* Brokerage Dadas led decliners, tumbling 8.62 percent to 5,300 tolars on volume of 15 shares.
* Petrol trader Petrol had the highest turnover, falling 5.37 percent to 18,850 tolars on volume of 3,857 shares for a total turnover of 74.5 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
